AccountSummary.title: AccountSummary
AccountSummary.description: An account as the outside world sees it (never the password hash).

url.title: Url
url.description: https, http, ssh (`ssh://` or `git@host:org/repo.git`) or file URL, without credentials.

library_id.title: Library Id
library_id.description: `/owner/repo`; omitted: the one proposed from the URL.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: A tag, a branch or a full or short commit SHA; omitted: the default branch.

include_paths.title: Include Paths
include_paths.description: Folders, files or globs to import; empty: every `.md`/`.mdx` file.

exclude_paths.title: Exclude Paths
exclude_paths.description: Folders, files or globs to leave out; they win.

AddLibraryCommand.title: AddLibraryCommand
AddLibraryCommand.description: Create a library from a git repository, with its doc selection, and queue its import.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: The tag or branch name, or the full SHA of a commit.

AddedLibrary.title: AddedLibrary
AddedLibrary.description: The new library, the commit its ref was pinned to, and the queued import.

Article.title: Article
Article.description: One article with its Markdown and the commit it comes from.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page.

ArticleList.title: ArticleList
ArticleList.description: A page of articles of one manifest, sorted by path.

ArticleSummary.title: ArticleSummary
ArticleSummary.description: An article as listed in a tree: no content.

AuthenticateQuery.title: AuthenticateQuery
AuthenticateQuery.description: A username and password to check.

url.title: Url
url.description: https, http, ssh (`ssh://` or `git@host:org/repo.git`) or file URL, without credentials.

CheckRepositoryCommand.title: CheckRepositoryCommand
CheckRepositoryCommand.description: Ask whether a git URL works, before anything is saved.

host.description: The hosting service, for source links.

default_branch.title: Default Branch
default_branch.description: The branch `HEAD` points at; null for an empty repository.

CheckedRepository.title: CheckedRepository
CheckedRepository.description: A reachable git repository and what a new library from it would look like.

ChunkingOut.title: ChunkingOut
ChunkingOut.description: How articles are cut into chunks.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: Lower bound: matching chunks the search looked at, at most `limit` + 1.

reranked.title: Reranked
reranked.description: Of those, how many a reranker reordered.

complete.title: Complete
complete.description: False when more matches exist than `limit` allowed.

CoverageOut.title: CoverageOut
CoverageOut.description: How much of the index the answer stands on.

CreateFirstAdminCommand.title: CreateFirstAdminCommand
CreateFirstAdminCommand.description: The first admin's credentials. The password is a ``SecretStr``: never shown in a repr.

CreateTokenCommand.title: CreateTokenCommand
CreateTokenCommand.description: A new API token for the caller. ``expires_at`` (timezone-aware) is optional.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: The one error shape of the API: a stable machine ``error`` code and a human ``detail``.

FileProblemSummary.title: FileProblemSummary
FileProblemSummary.description: A file the job skipped and the reason.

HostKind.title: HostKind
HostKind.description: Where the repository is hosted; `git` is any other HTTPS/SSH git server.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page.

JobList.title: JobList
JobList.description: A page of the jobs of one library, newest first.

JobState.title: JobState
JobState.description: Where a job is in its life. Only ``queued`` and ``running`` jobs are unfinished.

commit_sha.title: Commit Sha
commit_sha.description: The commit `version` was pinned to, if any.

JobSummary.title: JobSummary
JobSummary.description: A job and how far it got. ``total`` is 0 until the job knows its size.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page.

LibraryList.title: LibraryList
LibraryList.description: A page of the libraries visible to the caller, sorted by ID.

LibrarySummary.title: LibrarySummary
LibrarySummary.description: A library and its version refs, sorted.

RefOut.title: RefOut
RefOut.description: A tag or branch and the commit it points at.

RepositoryHost.title: RepositoryHost
RepositoryHost.description: Where a repository is hosted, by exact host name; ``git`` is any other server.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True when branches or tags were cut at 1000 each.

RepositoryRefs.title: RepositoryRefs
RepositoryRefs.description: What a repository offers as a ref, for the picker. Sorted by name, 1000 of each at most.

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: True for the version `/owner/repo` resolves to.

ResolvedVersion.title: ResolvedVersion
ResolvedVersion.description: The version an ID resolved to; always states which one was used.

RetrievalMode.title: RetrievalMode
RetrievalMode.description: How a search found its results. One result shape serves every mode.

fallback_reason.title: Fallback Reason
fallback_reason.description: Why a better mode was not used, when one was asked for.

SearchDocsResult.title: SearchDocsResult
SearchDocsResult.description: Results of one search, best first, with the version and the way they were found.

position.title: Position
position.description: 0-based index of the chunk in its article.

total.title: Total
total.description: Number of chunks of the article.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Link to the section at the commit; null when the host is unknown.

score.title: Score
score.description: Higher is better; only comparable within one search.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: Verbatim text of the chunk, possibly cut at either end.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.description: Offsets into `snippet` of the words that matched.

SearchResultOut.title: SearchResultOut
SearchResultOut.description: One verbatim result with where it lives and how to read around it.

SessionState.title: SessionState
SessionState.description: What the UI needs to know first: is setup due, is anyone signed in, and who.

TagMatch.title: TagMatch
TagMatch.description: How a tag filter combines its tags.

TokenGrant.title: TokenGrant
TokenGrant.description: A new token. ``token`` is the only copy of the secret and is never shown again.

TokenSummary.title: TokenSummary
TokenSummary.description: A token as listed: everything but the secret.

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: True for the version `/owner/repo` resolves to.

VersionOut.title: VersionOut
VersionOut.description: One imported version: the ref, what kind of ref it is, and the commit it stands for.

exactdocs__catalog__models__RefKind.title: RefKind
exactdocs__catalog__models__RefKind.description: What a version was imported from.

exactdocs__ingestion__models__RefKind.title: RefKind
exactdocs__ingestion__models__RefKind.description: What a requested ref turned out to be.
